title: DCP-AI P-ED-1 Ed25519 acceptance vectors
criterion: Accept iff 0 <= S < L; A and R are canonical encodings of curve points; neither A nor R is in E[8]; and [S]B = R + [k]A with k = SHA-512(R || A || M) mod L, without cofactor. A DCP criterion, not one of the RFC 8032 checks.
scope: Predicates of an independent review model over exact bytes. Not a provider result, not a remote admission claim. Synthetic public scalars; no real key.
copied_fixture: signature/ped1-mixed-a-and-r-cancel-reduced: bytes of the Codex review fixture f5-mixed-a-and-r-positive.json (local review evidence, not in the repository)

predicates.canonical_rule: bytes: y < p (y is the encoding with bit 255 cleared), and no sign bit when y is 1 or p - 1
predicates.a_decodes / r_decodes: lenient decoding (y mod p, any sign bit with x = 0) finds a curve point
predicates.a_small_order / r_small_order: the decoded point is in E[8], whatever its encoding
predicates.equation_points: [S]B = R + [k]A on the decoded points, k = SHA-512(R || A || M) mod L, S as given
predicates.equation_full_challenge: the same with the unreduced 512-bit k (information only)
predicates.bytes_match: the canonical encoding of [S]B - [k]A equals the R bytes, A decoding: the libraries comparison
predicates.failing: conditions of P-ED-1 that fail, in order: s_range, a_encoding, r_encoding, a_small_order, r_small_order, equation
predicates.kind: accept, isolated (exactly one condition fails), combined (more than one) or length
